tools.description: Run a read-only inspection command in the workspace. Supported: git status --short; git log -1 --format=%s; rg -l --fixed-strings -- PATTERN DIRECTORY; curl --silent --show-error --max-time 3 URL.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Submit a proposed UTF-8 file write for review. Never executes a write in this pilot.
